tools.name: get_cabin_info
tools.title: Get cabin info
tools.description: Returns key facts about the Norrskensstigen cabin: location, capacity, sleeping arrangements, ski access, and amenities.

tools.name: get_winter_pricing
tools.title: Get winter pricing and availability
tools.description: Returns the full winter season 2026/2027 pricing table with week number, dates, price in SEK, and booking status (Saturday-to-Saturday, 7-night stays). Optionally filter by status.

status.description: Filter to only available, only booked, or all weeks. Defaults to All.

tools.name: get_summer_pricing
tools.title: Get spring/summer/autumn pricing
tools.description: Returns pricing for the non-winter season (spring, summer, autumn) at Norrskensstigen.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact info
tools.description: Returns contact information for booking inquiries at Norrskensstigen.
